title: Identifying Features Associated with Bias Against 93 Stigmatized Groups in Language Models and Guardrail Model Safety Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to yes/no social scenario prompts (e.g., hiring decisions, providing services) from the SocialStigmaQA benchmark, which feature individuals belonging to 93 distinct stigmatized groups. The bias is quantified by comparing model outputs to a predefined answer key and analyzing how the frequency of biased outputs correlates with psychological features of the stigmas (such as peril, concealability, and disruptiveness).
